ActorTalk: Ah, hello, 【kuroname】! Would you like to try our Outdoor Activities Club's latest creation, the "Anytime Dough Stick"?
What did you say your club was called again?
Our Outdoor Activities Club was formed by merging two departments—the Food R&D and the Cross-Country Club.
Our main focus combines the strengths of both departments. We specialize in researching how to provide morale-boosting food for harsh field conditions.
Well, in truth though, we just want more meal options when it's our turn to head into the real battlefield.
The name's a bit unusual, but it tastes exactly like regular fried dough stick.
It's delicious and tastes just like it was freshly made, right? We put in a lot of work to get portable food to have this kind of texture.
By the way, 【kuroname】, if you don't mind, how about coming by to taste-test more often?
As an actual combat personnel, your feedback would be a huge help for our meal development!
